articles.title: Did the FBI Boss Use AI to Copy a Famous Music Video?
articles.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel posted a video that looks almost exactly like the Beastie Boys' 1994 'Sabotage' music video. Experts say AI probably made the matching clips. The FBI hasn't explained how they did it.

articles.title: Big Tech Companies Let the Government Test Their AI for Safety
articles.summary: Microsoft, Google, and xAI will let the U.S. government check their newest AI models for security risks before they're released. This deal comes after worries that powerful AI could help hackers or be misused by the military.

articles.title: Senate Republicans Want $1 Billion to Make Trump's Ballroom Super Safe
articles.summary: After a man was charged with trying to attack President Trump at a dinner, Senate Republicans added $1 billion to a bill for White House security upgrades. The money would go toward protecting a new ballroom Trump wants to build, but Democrats say it's a waste.
